lead_independence.headline: Man arrested after hit-and-run crash, two-hour manhunt through Palm City swamp
lead_independence.lead: Martin County deputies arrested Likenson Daceus on Friday after he fled a hit-and-run crash on SW Rivers End Way and Murphy Road in Palm City and led law enforcement through dense woods and swamp for two hours before being captured a quarter mile into Palm City natural lands. source_focus.source_title: 'Trying to swim and get away from those drones': Martin County uses multiple drones to catch suspect - WPBF
source_focus.source_lead: Martin County sheriff's deputies used multiple drones to locate and apprehend a hit-and-run suspect hiding underwater in a swamp earlier this week. Major Ruben Romero said drones are a tool that has helped law enforcement in recent times. "We saw alligators, we saw snakes, and this is a tool that kind of helps us navigate this kind of terrain and keeps our deputies and the community safe," Romero said.
